system.attitude: If your group faced a problem because you refused to change your approach to a situation, gain growth.
system.description:
Once you’ve decided on something, nothing changes your mind.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Resolve and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Study or Survive.

  • Bonds: When you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a supportive bond.

  • Drive: Each time you save one or more Momentum into the group pool, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: Your determination makes you inflexible, and unable to change when defeat looms. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Despairing.

  • Attitude: If your group faced a problem because you refused to change your approach to a situation, gain growth.
